objective: Replace the invalid 180-sample scope inference with a universal proof over every admissible input of the exact frozen V2 Tool Discovery generator.
theorem: V2 partitions every nonnegative ordinal into exactly six classes by ordinal mod 6.

For a fixed class, V1 seed randomness changes only a shared string suffix used to rename tool/capability/task identifiers; substantive costs, eligibility, capability incidence, requirements and mutation semantics are fixed.

The exact candidate is invariant to that renaming for correctness: tool order is fixed by unique costs; generated capability labels preserve role order; evidence is keyed consistently to the same renamed symbols.
Therefore one representative per class is a complete structural quotient of all admissible generator inputs.
All six representatives satisfy the exact scorer, including transfer, version invalidation, availability/authorization, least-cost choice, and no-route escalation.
The worst case needs at most eight relevant probes plus one terminal select/escalate action, below the evaluator budgets.
